description: Dossier d'information sur les canaux, condition 31/12/2002 is a dataset listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Vlaamse Milieu Maatschappij. Commissioned by AMINAL, dept. of water, a methodology has been developed for the inventory of canal systems and the creation of a database. Coverage: Vlaamse Milieu Maatschappij. The portal shows the English title as "Canals Information File, condition 31/12/2002" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Vlaamse Milieu Maatschappij. Its keywords include GRACHTTRAJECT, WATERPARTIJ, WATERBEHEER, GRACHTKNOOP, MOLENBEEK, GRACHTSEGMENT. The listing shows 2002-12-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
